verdict.rationale: 2FAS explicitly states in its machine-readable pricing docs that there is 'no telemetry' at all, meaning there's nothing to opt out of by design — a strong privacy-by-default posture. However, this is a single terse claim rather than a detailed privacy policy or explicit settings toggle, and there's no independent corroboration of the no-telemetry claim. Missing for 10: a dedicated privacy policy or settings page detailing what data (if any) is collected, and independent/community verification of the no-telemetry claim.
